records.name: Goose
records.vendor: AAIF (Agentic AI Foundation, Linux Foundation); originally Block
records.version: 1.55.0 (workspace bump at pin; latest GitHub release v1.54.0, 2026-10-08); GDK crates 0.1.0-alpha.12
records.one_liner: MCP-native Rust agent (CLI, Electron desktop, ACP HTTP/WS server) whose loop was just rewritten as a re-entrant, persistence-first state machine (goose-agent GDK crate) of 18 first-match Operations plus Inference over a SQLite-persisted conversation, with ~85 provider ids including other agents wrapped over ACP.

dims.loop: goose-agent StateMachine walks Vec<Step> first-match. Goose's pipeline is SlashCommand → ToolApproval → Skill → Recipe → ToolExecution → RemainingToolCalls → Subagent → Steer → BangShell → [Compaction] → ToolPairCompaction → Doctor → Project → Retry → EmptyResponse → StopHook → ExitOnError → MaxTurns(1000) → Inference. The session is reloaded every step; effects are persisted; tool calls in one message run concurrently via select_all.
dims.providers: A single Provider::stream trait backs ~36 native providers, 49 declarative JSON OpenAI-compatible endpoints, runtime custom providers, llama.cpp/MLX local inference and a toolshim for non-tool models. ACP/CLI wrappers turn Claude Agent, codex-acp, pi-acp, Amp, Copilot and Cursor into providers. Prompt-cache semantics are declared per provider/model and tested by prefix invariance; usage goes to a ledger with cost.
dims.tools: Every tool is an MCP Tool behind McpClientTrait, including in-process platform extensions (developer: write/edit/shell/tree/read_image; analyze; summon; skills; todo; code_execution via pctx/V8). Names are prefixed ext__tool unless first-class. A per-inference ExtensionLease pins the catalog. Shell output is capped at 2000 lines/50KB; responses over 200k chars spill to temp files.
dims.context: Short, cache-stable system.md (hour-truncated time, sorted extensions, Unicode-tag sanitizing). .goosehints and AGENTS.md load global plus git-root-to-cwd, lazily in subdirectories. A per-turn agent-only MOIM message carries time/cwd/budget. Auto-compaction at min(0.8, 225k/limit), plus reactive on context errors, hides originals from the agent (still user-visible). Opt-in tool-pair summarization.
dims.state: SQLite sessions.db (WAL, schema v17) holds sessions/messages/usage_ledger tables; SessionType includes User/SubAgent/Scheduled/Acp. Effects are committed per step and operation notes live in message metadata. Approvals resume after restart via ACP session/load. Supports fork (copy+truncate), export JSON/MD/HTML, and import of Claude Code/Codex/Pi jsonl. No file checkpoints/undo or crash re-drive.
dims.safety: GooseMode Auto (default)/Approve/SmartApprove (LLM judge, readOnlyHint)/Chat, with per-tool permission.yaml. Overriding inspectors: regex+ML prompt-injection scanner (off by default), log-only egress, opt-in fail-open LLM adversary. Also blocking PreToolUse hooks, an OSV MAL-* check for npx/uvx, and an env-var denylist. No OS sandbox; --container docker-execs only MCP extensions.
dims.extensibility: MCP extensions: platform, builtin (in-memory duplex), stdio, streamable_http with OAuth/UDS; SSE removed, no sampling. 12 hook events in hooks.json (Open Plugins spec). Git-installed plugins in Open Plugins or Gemini-extension format. SKILL.md discovery includes .agents/.claude/.goose. YAML recipes with params, sub-recipes, JSON-schema output and retry checks; custom providers.
dims.multi_agent: summon.delegate creates persisted SubAgent sessions (per-delegate provider/model/extensions/max_turns, default 25). SubagentOperation runs them in parallel on a JoinSet and forwards approvals to the parent. Depth-1 only (subagents cannot delegate); no handoffs or worktree isolation. Cron scheduler runs recipes; goose roam drives peer agents over iroh; goosetown is external.
dims.surfaces: CLI (session/run with json/stream-json, in-process Agent). goose acp (stdio) and goose serve (ACP HTTP/WS /acp, TLS, token auth, 83 _goose/unstable requests). The Electron desktop spawns goose serve. Also Telegram gateway, iroh roaming, goose mcp bundled servers, Zed via ACP with client fs/terminal routing, and a UniFFI Python/Kotlin SDK (providers+compaction only).
dims.observability: tracing spans with GenAI semconv (invoke_agent, chat, execute_tool, cache tokens; content only via OTEL_INSTRUMENTATION_GENAI_CAPTURE_MESSAGE_CONTENT). OTLP export via the otel feature, a Langfuse layer, and opt-in PostHog. ACP propagates trace context. The SDK has ObservabilityHook. Eval: in-repo harbor Terminal-Bench-2 runner (vendor-reported 57.3% code-mode vs OpenCode 52.8%, Pi 47.2%).

builds_on: rmcp (official MCP Rust SDK) — tool model, client/server transports; even in-process tools speak MCP
agent-client-protocol / agent-client-protocol-http crates — ACP server and ACP-client providers
Pi (pi-ai/pi coding agent) — wrapped as provider via pi-acp adapter; Pi .jsonl sessions importable
Claude Code — wrapped via claude-agent-acp (claude-acp) and legacy claude CLI provider; .jsonl import; ~/.claude/skills discovery
Codex — wrapped via codex-acp and codex CLI; chatgpt_codex OAuth provider; Codex .jsonl import
Gemini CLI — gemini-cli provider and Gemini extension (gemini-extension.json) plugin format
Kimi Code — kimi_code subscription API provider (api.kimi.com/coding)
OpenCode — opencode_zen/opencode_go declarative providers; harbor eval comparison
Open Plugins spec — hooks.json and plugin manifest format
AGENTS.md (AAIF sibling project) — default context file
used_by: Zed and other ACP clients — via goose acp / goose serve
Goose Desktop (Electron) and @aaif/goose-acp-client — consume goose serve over ACP
aaif-goose/goosetown — parallel multi-agent orchestration on goose (separate repo)
harbor / Terminal-Bench — ships a vanilla Goose harness (per evals/harbor README)
key_insights: The classic agent loop was deleted days before the pin (#12760, GDK 0.1.0-alpha.12, 2026-10-13). Agent::reply now drives goose-agent's StateMachine, which reloads the session from SQLite before every step and persists each step's effects. A test runner rebuilds the whole machine after every applied step to prove no progress hides in locals.

State that operations must remember lives on persisted messages as 'operation notes' (MessageMetadata.operations), e.g. retry attempts on the kickoff message, advertised tools, stop-hook denials and delivered subagents. Approvals therefore yield instead of blocking and resume after restart via ACP session/load. The notes keys have become a compatibility surface.

Goose is both an ACP server and an ACP client. It wraps Claude Agent, codex-acp, pi-acp, Amp, Copilot and Cursor as Providers with manages_own_context, which disables Goose's own compaction and local stdio/HTTP extensions and passes MCP servers through instead. It also imports Claude Code/Codex/Pi .jsonl sessions, so it can act as a UI and orchestration shell over competitors' harnesses.

goosed is gone: the Electron desktop spawns `goose serve` and speaks ACP over HTTP/WS with 83 `_goose/unstable/*` extension requests. The CLI still embeds the Agent in-process, so two integration paths remain. The April 2026 TS TUI is deprecated, and the announced Tauri desktop is not in the pin (still Electron 43).

Cache-first context engineering: the system prompt is stable (hour-granular timestamp, sorted extensions), volatile per-turn data goes into a persisted agent-only turn-context message reused byte-for-byte, and CacheSemantics breakpoints are declared per provider/model with a prefix-invariance test. Compaction is non-destructive, flipping originals to agent_visible=false.

Safety defaults are permissive. GooseMode::Auto is the default, the prompt-injection scanner is off, the egress inspector only logs, the adversary LLM reviewer is opt-in and fails open, and there is no OS sandbox. --container docker-execs MCP extensions, but the in-process developer shell (a platform extension) has no container reference, so it likely runs on the host.

Everything is MCP even in-process: platform extensions implement McpClientTrait, and bundled servers run over tokio duplex pipes. A per-inference ExtensionLease pins the tool catalog so advertised and dispatched tools match. SSE transport and MCP sampling were removed, and stdio packages are checked against OSV MAL-* advisories before spawn.

Subagents are persisted SubAgent sessions created by summon.delegate and run in parallel on a JoinSet with approval forwarding. They are capped at depth 1 (delegates cannot delegate), and background subagents were removed.

features_notes.in_process_sdk: Rust GDK is alpha; Python/Kotlin bindings cover providers and compaction, not the full loop.
features_notes.durable_resume: Persistent approval continuation; not general mid-tool crash replay.

verification.method: Independent targeted static source review plus repository-wide mechanical citation validation; no runtime tests
